name: Deepmark
descriptionSeed: An underground dwarven kingdom in the deep stone beneath the Given Land. The Masons above hold that only what can be touched is real; the dwarves of Deepmark hold that the deepest stone is the only thing in the world that has never lied, and they have gone down to live next to it.
encounterFlavor: deep-miners, stone-readers, and a court that speaks only in weights and measures
axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180).
worldPosNote: SNG-670: placed on the world's own deep_stone (Erik 2026-10-04: "they live in pockets across the world, in the typical places of their kind"). Below ground: depth -1.
appearance: A stair cut into the Given Land's bedrock that does not stop, then halls of black stone lit by forge-glow, and a throne carved from the floor rather than set on it.
_sng670: A pocket: a centre with its own ground, the way a foothill is. Its people are not a tradition; its ruling power and leader come in pass 2.
